title: Looking for the unexpected in Euclid DR1 with Claude: pre-registered tests of an LLM anomaly inspector and a compact lensed-quasar search (first results)
description: Pre-registrations (with SHA-256 hashes), amendments, reports and null results from two probes on Euclid DR1 (public since 12 November 2026). Track D tests whether a vision-language model (Claude Haiku 5.5; exploratory comparison with Sonnet 5.5 and Fable 5.2) can flag unusual objects in Euclid cutouts, using planted fakes under a sealed key, unlabelled known lenses, and thresholds fixed in advance. Track A tests a one-versus-two point-source fit for sub-arcsecond lensed quasars with injection-calibrated completeness and separately calibrated false alarms. Both tracks fail some of their pre-registered bars; the failures and sensitivities are reported in full.
